content.text: Sign in to confirm you’re not a bot This helps protect our community. Learn more Welcome back to Vanuatu and your next holiday destination! Is this the best kept secret? Come spend some time on Espiritu Santo with us and we'll show you... 🇻🇺 ⬇ Click MORE for our Vanuatu recommendations ⬇ Welcome back to Vanuatu and episode 2 from this series! We're on a beautiful island called Espiritu Santo, known as Santo Island locally, and it is an absolute paradise! Santo is the largest island in Vanuatu - there are beaches and rainforest, blue lagoon options everywhere, amazing food, friendly locals, lots of things to do and rich history and culture too. This isn't just a drop on the beach or beside the pool destination, there are so many epic things to do in Vanuatu and on Santo in particular. Check the links below for the tours we did, just note this is still a developing area for tourism so they're Facebook links and you'll likely have to reach out to them to chat about booking (a lot of tours a booked when you arrive through your accommodation). Just a reminder: for everything else, be a legend and book your travels to Vanuatu (or anywhere else in the world) by using the links below and you'll pay the same price, while supporting our channel.
